class.name: MIDIListener
class.brief_description: A node that receives MIDI input events through Godot's input system.
class.description:
MIDIListener is a helper node for receiving MIDI input events through Godot's input system.
Only the current MIDIListener processes MIDI events. When the first listener enters the scene tree, it becomes the current listener automatically. Additional listeners can be made current using [method make_current].
When the current listener receives an [InputEventMIDI], it emits the [signal midi_event] signal with the event as its argument.
The listener stops being current when it exits the scene tree if it was the current listener. MIDI input events are ignored by listeners that are not current.

method.name: make_current
method.description: Makes this listener the current MIDI listener. Only the current listener receives and emits MIDI input events.

method.name: is_current
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this listener is the current MIDI listener.

signal.name: midi_event
signal.description: Emitted when the current listener receives a MIDI input event.
